description: Two honest obstructions on the c₃ magnitude |S_p/S_m|≈4.075 (follow-up to the single-pair MISS #4497). A convergent realisation needs the full (non-truncated) 𝔙₄₁ or a cutoff (fit) — leading-form sum is not a parameter-free magnitude source (scope-(a), ingredient survives). (2) The resurgent one-instanton ratio is CIRCULAR: at near-identical anchor q₀ the e^{−Re𝔙/πℏ} prefactors cancel, so |S_p/S_m|≈|sin(Im𝔙_p/πℏ)/sin(Im𝔙_m/πℏ)| with Im𝔙=S itself — reduces to the open u(q₀), confirming #4246. Magnitude stays open. No fit; nothing wired; no instance fabricated.
